provider: CUHK Bachelor of Education in Early Childhood Education Programme Study Scheme and Course List
academicYear: Current official materials uploaded in August 2025; reviewed on 2026-08-24
note: The official two-page Study Scheme PDF (151,137 bytes; SHA-256 b27534694cede2b09863f48d545f40cdb108fd7447386cf1be6a9629fad9fcbc) was text-extracted and visually reviewed page by page. It publishes a minimum 111-unit Major: 9 Faculty Package units, 40 Core units, 6 Research Experience units, 10 Teaching Practice units and 46 Elective units. The official Course List image (6250 x 18613 pixels; SHA-256 42a595affa33094553b2ad40e7275f43d3305f02e62d07ceae941febd5b7aad5) was visually reviewed and OCR-assisted in overlapping segments. It publishes 61 unique code-title-unit rows: 3 Faculty Package, 14 Core, 2 Research Experience, 2 Teaching Practice and 40 Elective courses. The PDF and image agree on every code and unit. Electives require at least 26 units from pool (a), at least 11 units from pool (b), a maximum of 9 units from pool (c), and 46 units overall; the pools contain 1-, 2- and 3-unit courses. The current local rule engine cannot prove all category minimum/maximum and mixed-unit combinations. Therefore the complete 61-course list remains browse-only with totalCreditRequired=0 and no graduation completion percentage. The official [a] Capstone markers and the fixed-course recommended Year/Term pattern are retained as planning metadata rather than simplified into an automatic completion decision.
